newsitem.title: USA: Hayes Micro licenses Aware ASDL technology.
newsitem.headline: Hayes Micro licenses Aware ASDL technology.

text.p: Aware Inc Tuesday said Hayes Microcomputer Products Inc will license Aware's high-speed ASDL technology, data communications software and ADSL hardware modules to develop modems.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
ASDL, or asymmetric digital subscriber line, is a technology capable of delivering multi-megabit per second data transmission over standard telephone wires.
"Communications users want the fastest speeds possible when they're downloading information on the Internet or connecting to their corporate LAN," said Joseph Formichelli, chief executive of Hayes.
